summary: The UTE A1 centre: the plugin-side modules that replace the retired execution route, and the host-free suites that drive them. They run under node by construction (the admission port owns an AbortController/AbortSignal pair over the host's cancel signal, the realm lane schedules a settle timer, and the suites reach URL/process/fetch/AbortController), while the TypeScript package tree stays global-free so the client half remains browser-safe. Listed per file rather than per directory: the u7-w0 collection law wants 'exactly these .mjs files', and a directory pattern here would hand node globals to any later vnext module that might be browser-side. Adding a node-side vnext module appends one line to THIS file and edits nothing in eslint.config.mjs.
